description: Record whether an agent called or ignored a tool. Stores the name, a SHA-256 of the description, and the result. Does not store the raw description.

client.description: Optional short label such as cursor. No account ids.

description.description: Hashed with SHA-256 and not stored

name.description: Tool name that was offered to the agent

report_id.description: Optional idempotency key, 8 to 80 letters, digits, underscore or hyphen

result.description: Whether an agent called the tool

name: report_outcome
title: Report whether a tool was called
